policy: Direct digital input at 16 kHz. Replace only each Nyx address with the exact frozen 1.10 s WAV ending at the forced-aligned first command word. Consume leading inter-utterance silence if necessary. Preserve all command and distractor PCM. Same continuous C161+v5 native host detector for original, silence and cue streams. Round notification up to a 256-sample block, retain two seconds, transcribe through 400 ms past utterance end. Physical room and Opus are outside this comparison. No adjustment of detector parameters or cue amplitude.
